claims.label: Kent Resignation Effective Day of Letter
claims.claim: Joe Kent's letter states he has resigned from the Director of the National Counterterrorism Center effective the day of the letter, citing inability in good conscience to support the ongoing war in Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the date of the letter against public Federal Register / White House personnel announcement records to confirm effective date and replacement timeline.

claims.label: Kent: Iran Posed No Imminent Threat
claims.claim: Kent's resignation letter asserts that "Iran posed no imminent threat to our nation."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kent's stated threat assessment against publicly available U.S. intelligence community products and ODNI statements from the relevant period.

claims.label: Kent Attributes War Initiation to Israel and American Lobby
claims.claim: Kent's letter states that the U.S. started the war "due to pressure from Israel and its powerful American lobby."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Kent's specific allegations against any documented lobbying communications or pressure patterns referenced in his letter.

claims.label: Kent Self-Identifies as 11-Time Combat Veteran and Gold Star Husband
claims.claim: Kent's letter identifies him as a veteran who deployed to combat 11 times and a gold star husband who lost his wife Shannon in a war manufactured by Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Kent's DD-214-equivalent service record and Shannon Kent's military casualty record against publicly available DoD releases.

claims.label: Trump Describes Kent as "Weak on Security"
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, President Trump, asked about Joe Kent's resignation, says he read Kent's statement and describes Kent as "weak on security."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm exact wording against the full White House transcript or press pool video of the same appearance.

claims.label: Trump Cites Termination of Iran Nuclear Deal in Defense of War
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, President Trump defends the Iran campaign by referencing his prior termination of the Obama-era Iran nuclear deal, saying that absent termination there would have been a "nuclear holocaust."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm specific language against the official White House transcript of the appearance.

claims.label: Graham Characterizes Kent Resignation as Democratic Talking Points
claims.claim: Senator Lindsey Graham publicly stated that Kent's resignation "could not have come at a better time" and that Kent's statement was echoing "Democratic talking points."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact X post text against Graham's verified account at the timestamp indicated.

claims.label: Levin Suggests Kent Was About to Be Fired
claims.claim: Per a post the host reads from Mark Levin, Levin speculated that Kent "was about to be fired but quickly resigned first."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against Levin's verified X account and compare with any subsequent official statements about Kent's separation.

claims.label: Host Says Levin Called for DOJ Criminal Investigation of Kent
claims.claim: The host says Mark Levin called for the DOJ to open a criminal investigation to determine if Kent leaked classified information.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against Levin's verified X account and monitor for any DOJ response.

claims.label: Loomer Alleges Kent's Wife Worked for Max Blumenthal
claims.claim: Laura Loomer publicly alleged that Kent's wife works for Max Blumenthal and used this to characterize Kent as disrespectful to Trump.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Loomer's allegation against Shannon Kent's actual employment record (she is deceased per Kent's own letter); check for fact-check rebuttals.

claims.label: Dershowitz Calls Kent a "Neo-Nazi Jew Hating Israel Basher"
claims.claim: Per a post the host reads, Alan Dershowitz referred to Kent as a "neo-Nazi Jew hating Israel basher" who had quit the administration.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm exact text against Dershowitz's verified X account.

claims.label: Budowich Calls Kent a "Crazed Egomaniac"
claims.claim: The host says Taylor Budowich, in a tweet, described Kent as a "crazed egomaniac" who was "often at the center of national security leaks."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm exact text against Budowich's verified X account.

claims.label: Theo Von Calls Israeli Political Leaders "Satanic"
claims.claim: Theo Von publicly characterized Israeli political leaders as feeling like "a satanic regime" and stated he does not understand the U.S. government's relationship with Israel's leaders.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against the original Theo Von podcast episode and timestamp.

claims.label: Local News Clip Says TPUSA Arkansas Chapter Announced Disaffiliation
claims.claim: In a local news segment the host plays, the report says the Turning Point USA University of Arkansas chapter announced it is disaffiliating from the national organization.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against an official TPUSA statement (or silence) on the disaffiliation and confirm the chapter's standing with national TPUSA.

claims.label: Local News Clip Reports the University of Arkansas Chapter Will Rebrand as Young American Revival
claims.claim: In a local news clip the host plays, the University of Arkansas TPUSA chapter is reported to be disaffiliating and rebranding as "Young American Revival," focused on advocating for Christian conservative values.
claims.investigative_direction: Track the new organization's filings and any subsequent national TPUSA response.

claims.label: Host Says Fonte Grassi Authored Chapter Statement
claims.claim: The host says the chapter president, Dino Fonte Grassi, published a letter on Instagram, and that the executive board's decision to disaffiliate was unanimous.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against Fonte Grassi's verified Instagram account; confirm "unanimous" via any other executive board members' public statements.

claims.label: Fonte Grassi Letter Characterizes "Charlie Would Have" Statements as Disingenuous
claims.claim: The Fonte Grassi letter states that since Charlie Kirk's assassination, "Statements like 'Charlie would have said.' and 'Charlie would have wanted.' have felt in many instances disingenuous and manipulative."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference specific TPUSA statements attributed to Charlie's posthumous voice against Kirk's documented prior positions.

claims.label: Host Says Fonte Grassi Participated in Kirk's July 2025 Israel/Gaza Discussion
claims.claim: The host says Dino Fonte Grassi participated in a July 2025 Charlie Kirk sit-down discussing Israel and Gaza with students.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the date, venue, and Fonte Grassi's participation against the original video; identify other participants.

claims.label: Bessent Pulled Mid-Interview to Situation Room
claims.claim: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was pulled mid-interview to attend the Situation Room, with the interviewer noting it was "a first" for an interviewee to be pulled.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against full interview video; identify the original outlet and date of the interview.

claims.label: Bessent States President in "Great Spirits"
claims.claim: Upon return from the Situation Room, Bessent publicly stated the president was in "great spirits" and that the Iranian mission was "proceeding well ahead of schedule."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm exact wording against interview transcript; cross-reference subsequent official Iran-mission updates.

claims.label: Host Says Three DC-Area Airports Shut Down March 13
claims.claim: The host says that on March 13, Reagan National (DCA), Baltimore-Washington (BWI), and Richmond (RIC) airports were simultaneously shut down.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against FAA ground stop records and the four-airport claim against actual reported closures.

claims.label: Host Says Official Closure Explanation Was Overheated Circuit Board
claims.claim: The host says the official explanation for the March 13 multi-airport shutdown was a "circuit board that overheated."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against official FAA / airport authority statements; investigate whether "circuit board" specificity was ever provided.

claims.label: Netanyahu Posts Official Account Video March 14
claims.claim: Following a rumored Iranian missile strike, Benjamin Netanyahu's official account posted a video on March 14 that appeared to viewers to have smoothed facial features.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against the official account's posting record; subject the video to forensic/AI-generation analysis.

claims.label: Netanyahu Misses Security Council Meeting
claims.claim: Netanyahu reportedly missed a Security Council meeting, described as unusual; Israel Katz is said to have run the meeting in his place.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against official Israeli government / Knesset scheduling records.

claims.label: Yair Netanyahu Social Media Silence Pattern
claims.claim: Yair Netanyahu, who normally retweets or tweets about 30 times per day, went completely silent for 7 days.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Yair Netanyahu's full X/Twitter activity log for the relevant window to verify the claimed silence.

claims.label: Netanyahu Posts Huckabee Video March 15
claims.claim: Benjamin Netanyahu posted a hyper-produced HD video with U.S. Ambassador Mike Huckabee on March 15, ostensibly to prove he is alive.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm posting timestamp against official channels; subject video to production analysis.

claims.label: Host Says Netanyahu No-Showed Military Council Meeting March 17
claims.claim: The host says Netanyahu no-showed a critical military council meeting on March 17, which she says was reportedly unprecedented.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against Israeli government press releases and Knesset/Prime Minister's Office daily schedule.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Appeared with Sarah Huckabee Sanders in Arkansas
claims.claim: The host says Erica Kirk visited Arkansas shortly before the disaffiliation announcement and appeared with Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify event date and content against Governor Sanders's official schedule and TPUSA press materials.

claims.label: Local News Clip Says Sanders Signed Proclamation Endorsing TPUSA School Chapters
claims.claim: In a local news segment the host plays, the reporter says Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders signed a proclamation endorsing TPUSA chapters in schools statewide.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the actual proclamation text from the Arkansas Secretary of State's office.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Characterizes "Prophecy as Policy" Theologically Problematic
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk, in a July 2025 student discussion, publicly stated that "I find prophecy as policy generally to be theologically problematic."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact quotation against the full original audio/video recording.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Publicly Questions Cruz's Use of Bible for Israel Aid
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Charlie Kirk questions Senator Ted Cruz's use of the Bible to justify U.S. aid to Israel, saying Cruz "doesn't even know the verse."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact quotation against the full original recording and identify any contemporaneous response from Cruz.

claims.label: Host Says India Refused Trump's Request for Troops at Hormuz
claims.claim: The host says Trump went to India and asked it to send troops to keep the Strait of Hormuz open, and that India answered that it would not get involved.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Indian government statements and press reports of any US request for naval or troop help in the Strait of Hormuz and India's reply.
claims.transcript_snippet: he went over there to like, "Hey, can you guys send some troops to the Strait of Hormuz? Uh we got to keep that open." And India came back and said, "Sorry, buddy, we're not getting involved."

claims.label: Host Says Shannon Kent Was Killed by a Suicide Bomber in Syria in 2019
claims.claim: The host says Joe Kent's late wife, Shannon Kent, was killed by a suicide bomber while serving in Syria in January 2019 and was the first female combat death in Syria since combat operations against ISIS began.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Department of Defense casualty release and contemporaneous news reports on the January 2019 Manbij bombing for the date, cause and the 'first female' description.
claims.transcript_snippet: Shannon was the first female combat combat death in Syria uh since combat operations began against ISIS.

claims.label: Host Says Shannon Kent Was First Female Service Member Killed by Enemy Fire in Over 3 Years
claims.claim: The host says Shannon Kent was also the first female US service member killed by enemy fire in more than three years up to that point.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against DoD casualty lists of female service members killed by hostile fire from 2015 to 2019.
claims.transcript_snippet: she was also the first female US service member that was killed by enemy fire in more than 3 years up until that point.

claims.label: Kent Letter Says Israeli Officials and US Media Ran a Misinformation Campaign
claims.claim: Joe Kent's resignation letter, as read by the host, says early in the administration high-ranking Israeli officials and influential members of the American media deployed a misinformation campaign that undermined Trump's America First platform and encouraged war with Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Kent or his office to identify the officials and outlets meant, and compare with the published text of the letter.
claims.transcript_snippet: high-ranking Israeli officials and influential members of the American media deployed a misinformation campaign that wholly undermined your America first platform and sowed pro-war sentiments to encourage a war with Iran.

claims.label: Kent Letter Says Trump Understood the Middle East Wars Were a Trap Until June 2025
claims.claim: The letter as read says that until June 2025 Trump understood that wars in the Middle East were a trap that cost American lives and wealth.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the letter's June 2025 turning point with the June 2025 strikes on Iran and Charlie Kirk's June 2025 opposition to the war.
claims.transcript_snippet: Until June of 2025, you understood that the wars in the Middle East were a trap that robbed America of the precious lives of our patriots and depleted the wealth and prosperity of our nation.

claims.label: Kent Letter Says Israel Used the Same Tactic to Draw the US Into Iraq
claims.claim: The letter as read says the claim that Iran posed an imminent threat was a lie and the same tactic Israelis used to draw the US into the Iraq war.
claims.investigative_direction: Evaluate the letter's Iraq comparison against the 2002 to 2003 intelligence record and any Israeli government statements of that period.
claims.transcript_snippet: This was a lie and is the same tactic the Israelis used to draw us into the disastrous Iraq war that cost our nation the lives of thousands of our best men and women.

claims.label: Trump Says He Is Glad Kent Is Out Because Kent Said Iran Was Not a Threat
claims.claim: In the clip Trump says that after reading Kent's statement he realized it is a good thing Kent is out, because Kent said Iran was not a threat.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify wording against the White House pool video of the same exchange.
claims.transcript_snippet: when I read his statement, I realized that it's a good thing that he's out because he said that Iran was not a threat.

claims.label: Trump Says Obama Flew Boeing 757s Loaded With Cash to Iran
claims.claim: In the clip Trump says the Obama administration sent two Boeing 757s loaded with hundreds of millions of dollars in cash to Iran, with the seats taken out, so much that no bank in Virginia, Maryland or DC had money left.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the documented 2016 US payments to Iran and Treasury and State Department records on the cash shipments.
claims.transcript_snippet: Hundreds of millions of dollars in a Boeing 757. I think there two of them. Loaded. They took the seats out and they put cash

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Described Yes-Men Around Leaders in Messages With Bret Weinstein
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk intimated in messages with Bret Weinstein that people close to a leader create a hive mentality and tell him everything will be perfect.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Kirk and Weinstein messages and check whether they say what the host describes.
claims.transcript_snippet: Exactly what Charlie had intimated in those messages with Bret Weinstein.

claims.label: Host Says the US Is the Only Country to Have Dropped Nuclear Weapons
claims.claim: The host says the only country that has ever dropped nuclear weapons is the United States, which she says is the country that cites nuclear threats to justify invading others.
claims.investigative_direction: Historical record (1945); recorded as said.
claims.transcript_snippet: The only country that has ever dropped nukes in the history of the world is us.

claims.label: Host Plays Netanyahu Clips Predicting Iran Was Close to a Bomb
claims.claim: The host plays a montage of Netanyahu-era warnings that Iran was months or years from a nuclear weapon, and says Iran has been said to be on the brink of nukes for three decades.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify each speaker, date and source of the montage clips and compare the predicted timelines with later IAEA assessments.
claims.transcript_snippet: Always on the brink of nukes over the course of three decades they've been on the brink of nukes.

claims.label: Levin Calls Kent Part of a Radical Isolationist Woke Right Cabal
claims.claim: Mark Levin's post, as read by the host, calls Kent part of the radical isolationist woke right cabal and says left-wing media will use him to attack the president and the campaign against Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm exact wording against Levin's X account.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's part of the radical isolationist woke right cabal.

claims.label: Loomer Says She Would Fire Everyone and Punish Leakers
claims.claim: Laura Loomer's post, as read by the host, says she would fire everyone to teach them a lesson, punish everyone who leaks, and stop putting Democrats in the administration.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm exact wording against Loomer's X account.
claims.transcript_snippet: I would fire everyone and teach them a lesson that they would never forget. Rule with an iron fist. Punish everyone who leaks and undermines you.

claims.label: Host Says Joe Kent Will Be Interviewed at Catholics for Catholics Thursday
claims.claim: The host says she will interview Joe Kent that Thursday at the Catholics for Catholics event in Washington, DC.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Catholics for Catholics program for the March 19, 2026 event and whether the interview took place.
claims.transcript_snippet: Joe Kent I'm going to be interviewing him this Thursday at the Catholics for Catholics event in DC.

claims.label: Host Says Event Is Not Anti-Zionist and Zionists Are Demanding Cancellations
claims.claim: The host says the Catholics for Catholics event is not an anti-Zionist conference and was never billed as one, with Carrie Prejean Bowler and the host speaking, and that critics have been emailing and calling to demand cancellations.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the organizers for the cancellation emails and calls received, and check the published event agenda.
claims.transcript_snippet: They have just been emailing everyone calling everybody asking for cancellations

claims.label: Host Says Netanyahu Is Wanted by the ICC and Was Welcomed at the White House
claims.claim: The host says Netanyahu, whom she calls a war criminal wanted by the ICC, is greeted at the White House without objection.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the ICC warrant record for Netanyahu and White House visit logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: will greet Bibi Netanyahu who is a literal war criminal wanted by the ICC in the White House

claims.label: Theo Von Says Israeli Leaders Show No Intent to Stop and No Care for Americans
claims.claim: In the clip Theo Von says he believes the attacks will come to America one day, that Israeli leaders have no intention of stopping, and that they have no care for the American people.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify wording against the original Theo Von podcast episode.
claims.transcript_snippet: I believe that that will come here one day. I don't believe that uh that the Israeli leaders that they have any intention to to stop that.

claims.label: Theo Von Says Children May Lose the Right to Speak Up by Law or Worse
claims.claim: In the clip Theo Von says that if people do not speak up now their children will not get the chance to, either by law or by worse.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify wording against the original Theo Von podcast episode.
claims.transcript_snippet: I believe that if we don't speak up now that our children won't have the chance to speak up. Either by law or by worse.

claims.label: Theo Von Says He Does Not Understand Why the US Is Beholden to Israel
claims.claim: In the clip Theo Von says he does not understand Trump's relationship with Israel or why the US is so beholden to an Israeli government he describes as obsessed with control.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify wording against the original Theo Von podcast episode.
claims.transcript_snippet: why we are so beholden to these to this government this Israeli government that that just seems to be obsessed with uh control.

claims.label: Host Says Catholics for Catholics Organizer Is Being Harassed Over the Event
claims.claim: The host says the organizer of Catholics for Catholics has been harassed because the event features someone who does not support what she calls mass murder in Gaza.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Catholics for Catholics for the harassment communications it received and compare with the host's description.
claims.transcript_snippet: the pain that they have put him through, the harassment that they have gone through because you're not allowed to have an event if it's with somebody that doesn't support mass murder in Gaza.

claims.label: Host Says Megyn Kelly Faces What Charlie Kirk Faced in the End
claims.claim: The host says Megyn Kelly's only apparent offense was telling the truth, and that what Kelly is going through now is what Charlie Kirk was going through at the end.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific campaign against Kelly the host means and compare with Kirk's reported Israel pressure in 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: she simply told the truth that what she is going through right now is what Charlie was going through in the end.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Is at the Helm While TPUSA Reverses Charlie's Positions
claims.claim: The host says Charlie's wife Erika is at the helm of Turning Point USA while people recognize the organization reversing course on everything Charlie expressed that he believed.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare TPUSA's public positions since September 2025 with Kirk's documented statements on Israel, Iran and donors.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika's at the helm of the company. Charlie's wife is at the helm of the company. Yet we are all recognizing that they are reversing course on everything that Charlie expressed that he believed.

claims.label: Host Says Joe Kent Bumped Heads With Kash Patel During the Kirk Investigation
claims.claim: The host says Joe Kent was one of the people who bumped heads with Kash Patel during the investigation into who killed Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the New York Times reporting on Patel, Kent and Gabbard and ask Kent about the dispute on stage.
claims.transcript_snippet: Joe Kent was one of the people who bumped heads with Kash Patel during the investigation into who killed Charlie Kirk
